title: Broken GPU spoofing in 148.0.7778.215
body:
Version **148.0.7778.215** for Windows has a major issue with GPU spoofing. This issue can potentially cause serious compatibility problems with websites protected by **Cloudflare Challenges** and possibly other anti-bot services.

In chrome://gpu/, under **Log Messages**, the following error appears:

```text
EGL Driver message (Error) eglCreateContext: Requested version is not supported
```

When visiting a website protected by Cloudflare Challenges, the challenge enters an infinite refresh loop and the user cannot access the website.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run fingerprint-chromium version 148.0.7778.215 on Windows.
2. Start the browser using the fingerprint parameter --fingerprint={seed}
3. Open the Cloudflare Challenges test page: https://rucaptcha.com/demo/cloudflare-turnstile-challenge
4. The challenge enters an infinite refresh loop and never completes.

## Workaround

The issue can be avoided by using one of the following launch parameters:

```text
--disable-spoofing=gpu
--disable-gpu
--use-angle=swiftshader
--use-angle=gl
```

With these parameters, the Cloudflare Challenges completes successfully.

title: Add flags to toggle fingerprint spoofing
body:
Currently, flag `--fingerprint={value}` changes these fields (according to spec):
- User-Agent
- Operating System
- Audio
- Plugins
- CPU Cores
- Memory
- WebGL Image
- WebGL Metadata
- Fonts
- Canvas Image
- Canvas Text
- ClientRects
- WebRTC
- Language Support
- Timezone Support

I think it would be very handy to add some kind of `--disable-spoofing={value1,value2,value3,....}` flag, that can intake comma-separated values.
For example, most of the time i don't want to spoof Fonts, Plugins and OS-related stuff like Operating System, CPU Cores and Memory.
Possible flag would look like:
`--disable-spoofing=fonts,plugins,operatingSystem,cpuCores,memory`

You already have `--disable-gpu-fingerprint` flag, but i think it would be cleaner to have a list-supporting flag.
Point is: spoofing is good, but to a certain point. Unrealistic Fonts, CPU and memory configs actually makes more harm - sites flag that as unrecognisable PC setup.

Hi,

I noticed there’s already ARM64 support for macOS builds, but there’s no packaged release for Intel-based Macs (x86_64). There are still many users on Intel hardware (MacBook Pro, iMac, Mac Mini, etc.) who would benefit from having an official prebuilt binary.

**Request:**
Add a build target for macOS Intel 64-bit (x86_64-apple-darwin)

Provide downloadable binaries/releases for this architecture, similar to the ARM64 macOS build

This would greatly help the community, since compiling Chromium-based projects from source on macOS Intel can be extremely time-consuming and error-prone.

Thanks for considering this addition!

title: Question: How to contribute patches for version 136.0.7103.113?

The issue was that several build targets were missing the required dependency. The patch adds "//components/ungoogled:ungoogled_switches" to the deps section in the following BUILD.gn files:
- `//components/embedder_support/BUILD.gn`
- `//third_party/blink/common/BUILD.gn`
- `//third_party/blink/renderer/core/BUILD.gn`
